content.text:
Confirmed: **£1,951,169.44 across 101 ad hoc earnings entries** is the defensible reported-payment total.

The literal employment-category sum is **£2,057,097.84**, but its additional £105,928.40 consists of monthly agreement rates:

- GB News: £97,928.40 monthly.
- Telegraph: two £4,000 monthly agreements, both attached to parent declaration 8909.

All three have null remuneration start/end dates. Their raw summaries say “Agreement”. They cannot establish cumulative earnings or be added as actual payments. Parent employment declarations 6852 and 8909 contain no amounts, so those parents do not duplicate monetary values.

Source decoder selects the latest published register version per declaration; it does not sum versions. It extracts `Value` without retaining the payment regularity in `funding_entries`, explaining why a database amount sum conflates rates with payments.

Exclude gifts and visits when describing earnings. No repository or database changes made.
